annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 2001/63/EC of 17 August 2001 adapting to technical progress Directive 97/68/EC on emissions of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive 2001/63/EC of 17 August 2001 adapting to technical progress Directive 97/68/EC on emissions of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 227
annotation.summary_en: Commission Directive 2001/63/EC adapts Directive 97/68/EC on emissions from engines in non-road mobile machinery to technical progress, amending test procedure annexes (water quench check, formulas) and reference fuel specifications to align with ECE Regulation 96. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Annexes III and IV of Directive 97/68/EC on emission test procedures and reference fuel.
Aligns requirements with ECE Regulation 96 to which the Community is party.
Member States must transpose by 30 June 2002.
Enters into force on the 20th day after publication.
